doc: Open container with a closed floor, one flat bar handle reaching far beyond the body, small balls. Body = thin-wall lathe ('polar' profile: wall thickness measured where inner and outer faces were both seen, closed floor = observed inner floor + t). Handle = the largest residual cluster that reaches beyond the body by more than k*s, fitted as a straight bar in its own plane whose inner end sits inside the body wall. Balls = generic free-fit balls on compact residual clusters (no radius prior). Reproduces hand kit A (prim_potlid.build_pot, variant fit) apart from the balls. Windows: the hand kit's absolute windows divided by s of its development episode (GT-free); whether each hand-kit window was set before or after a scan scoring of that kit is not recorded (work-log: two dev scorings per family) - treat them as development choices, not as tuned-free.
